say:2:1222405001:1.text: You guys are back! Did you manage to catch those fish from the Blackthorn Sea?
say:2:1222405001:1.source_cn: 可算等到你们回来了！怎么样，有没有在黑棘海里钓到那几种鱼？

choice_prompt:3:1222405001.text: You guys are back! Did you manage to catch those fish from the Blackthorn Sea?
choice_prompt:3:1222405001.source_cn: 可算等到你们回来了！怎么样，有没有在黑棘海里钓到那几种鱼？

say:4:1222405002:1.text: Wonderful! You're indeed the most promising fish catcher in Rustport!
say:4:1222405002:1.source_cn: ——太好了！你果然是锈锚港最有潜力的捕鱼人！
say:4:1222405002:1.male: Wonderful! You're indeed the most promising fish catcher in Rustport!
say:4:1222405002:1.female: Wonderful! You're indeed the most promising fish catcher in Rustport!

say:5:1222405004:1.text: I really appreciate your help! With these fish, I believe our research can proceed smoothly!
say:5:1222405004:1.source_cn: 这次也多谢你的帮忙！有了这些鱼，我们的研究报告一定能顺...
say:5:1222405004:1.male: I really appreciate your help! With these fish, I believe our research can proceed smoothly!
say:5:1222405004:1.female: I really appreciate your help! With these fish, I believe our research can proceed smoothly!

say:6:1222405005:1.text: Eh? "Your" research? Are you involved in the study too?
say:6:1222405005:1.source_cn: 哎？你们的研究报告……？你也开始研究锈锚港的鱼类了？

say:7:1222405006:1.text: That's right. The expert I'm assisting thinks I'm doing a great job, and he's decided to accept me as his student slash assistant.
say:7:1222405006:1.source_cn: 没错。我跟随的那位鱼类专家觉得我帮上了许多忙，所以打算...

say:8:1222405007:1.text: Most importantly, he's promised to make me the co-author of the research paper! This is much simpler than investigating the ruins, and we'll get results more quickly!
say:8:1222405007:1.source_cn: 最重要的是——他答应把锈锚港鱼类研究报告的二作留给我，...

say:9:1222405008:1.text: Ah, that explains why you're so enthusiastic this time...
say:9:1222405008:1.source_cn: 呃……难怪你这次会一反常态，变得这么积极……

say:10:1222405009:1.text: Well, the Conservatory has too many students and too few mentors. My previous mentor only checked in with me every couple of months because he had too many students...
say:10:1222405009:1.source_cn: 当然了。谁让冬青学会的学者那么多，导师却少之又少。我原...

say:11:1222405010:1.text: So, my mentor now is a rare find! I don't get why no other scholars have picked him. He's just, well... a bit bossy at times...
say:11:1222405010:1.source_cn: 所以说，我现在这位导师简直称得上绝无仅有！真不明白为什...

say:12:1222405011:1.text: Oh! I've got to pass these fish to him immediately, or he'll soon hunt me down to nag me!
say:12:1222405011:1.source_cn: ——啊！我得赶紧把这些鱼交给他，不然他又要跑出来催我了！！

say:13:1222405012:1.text: See you, everyone! Thanks for supporting the Fishing Society!
say:13:1222405012:1.source_cn: 再见啦，各位，谢谢你们对于钓鱼协会的支持！

choice:3:0:1.text: Of course, I'm a fishing expert!
choice:3:0:1.male: Of course, I'm a fishing expert!
choice:3:0:1.female: Of course, I'm a fishing expert!

say:15:1222405003:1.text: Don't worry, you'll surely get a fair reward from me!
say:15:1222405003:1.source_cn: 放心，我会给你合适的报酬~
say:15:1222405003:1.male: Don't worry, you'll surely get a fair reward from me!
say:15:1222405003:1.female: Don't worry, you'll surely get a fair reward from me!

choice:3:1:2.text: These fish here are worth tons of gold.
choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 这可是价值几万金币的鱼
choice:3:1:2.male: These fish here are worth tons of gold.
choice:3:1:2.female: These fish here are worth tons of gold.
